findings.title: Heap-based buffer overflow in cw_acd daemon (FG-IR-25-084)
findings.summary_md: The Fortinet PSIRT advisory behind the story's CVE, published January 13, 2026 (page date only) and last updated February 23, 2026. It documents CVE-2025-25249 as a heap-based buffer overflow (CWE-122) in the FortiOS and FortiSwitchManager cw_acd daemon allowing remote unauthenticated code execution via crafted requests, discovered internally by Gwendal Guegniaud, scored CVSSv3 7.4 with a temporal vector, and notes ASLR and PIE considerably raise exploitation effort. It lists affected branches and fixes: FortiOS 7.6.4, 7.4.9, 7.2.12, 7.0.18 or above, migration off 6.4, FortiSwitchManager 7.2.7 and 7.0.6 or above, and two workarounds: removing 'fabric' from interface allowaccess, or blocking CAPWAP-CONTROL on UDP ports 5246-5249 with local-in policies that admit only trusted devices.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2025-25249
findings.summary_md: NVD published the record on 2026-01-13 17:15:56 UTC from Fortinet PSIRT, describing unauthorized code execution via specially crafted packets affecting FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.3, 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, 7.2.0 through 7.2.11, 7.0.0 through 7.0.17, FortiOS 6.4 all versions, and FortiSwitchManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.6 and 7.0.0 through 7.0.5. NVD scores it CVSS 3.1 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N) against the vendor metric's 8.1 (AC:H), and references the CISA KEV catalog entry for the CVE.

findings.title: Fortinet security advisory (AV26-023) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
findings.summary_md: The Cyber Centre advisory dated January 13, 2026 covering the same Fortinet advisory batch: FortiOS branches 7.6 down to 6.4.0-6.4.16, FortiSASE 25.2.b and 25.1.a.2, FortiSIEM 6.7 through 7.4, FortiSwitchManager 7.0 and 7.2, and FortiFone. Its page shows date modified 2026-09-09 for Update 1, which relays CISA's addition of CVE-2025-25249 to the KEV database and links FG-IR-25-084, confirming the KEV listing is the only change to this advisory in eight months.
